verses.text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

segments.text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

verses.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

segments.text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.

verses.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

segments.text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.

verses.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

segments.text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.

verses.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

segments.text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.

verses.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

segments.text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.

verses.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

segments.text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

verses.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

segments.text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.

verses.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

segments.text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.

verses.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

segments.text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.

verses.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

segments.text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.

verses.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.

segments.text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
